        Serve
        
      


      

        Note: The web app does not listen on a port. The Serve toggle saves your preference and documents the API. The real HTTP listener ships in the Electron build (Stage 6). The "Test with In-App Runner" button exercises the exact same handler code.
      


      
      

        
API Endpoints

        
        

          
POST /v1/tasks

          
Create a new agent task

          

curl -X POST http://localhost:PORT/v1/tasks \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Build a todo app", "mode": "plan-build"}'
          

        


        

          
GET /v1/tasks/:id

          
Get task status and result

          

curl http://localhost:PORT/v1/tasks/TASK_ID
          

        


        

          
POST /v1/tasks/:id/message

          
Send a message to a running task (steering, boomerang response, etc.)

          

curl -X POST http://localhost:PORT/v1/tasks/TASK_ID/message \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"type": "user-input", "content": "Continue with option A"}'
          

        

      


      
      

        
Configuration

        

          

            
            
            
Port for Electron listener (web app does not bind)

          

          

            
            
            
Default mode for API tasks

          

        

        

          
          
Enable CORS

        

        

          
          
Require API Key (future)

        

      


      
      

        
Test with In-App Runner

        
Exercises the exact same handler that the HTTP endpoint would use.

        Adversary Mode
        
      


      

        Adversary mode reviews plans and solutions, finding weak assumptions, unhandled edge cases, and over-complicated parts. Objections are filed as review comments (max 5 per round) and must be answered before the plan is accepted. Uses the cheap model for critique.

        Agent Hooks

        Powers
      


      

        Powers are capability packs defined in .devforge/powers.json. Each Power enables a set of tools/skills/MCPs for the project. Turning a Power OFF unloads its tools from the agent catalog (lazy loading). Powers never auto-install MCPs — install is always explicit.

        Detects repetitive failure patterns: same file edited 3× with same error, or same tool call failing 3× with same message. On detection: stops attack, writes stuck note to Brain, offers alternatives. Purely local rule-based — no model call.

        GitHub Trigger
      


      

        When a repo is linked (GitHub MCP), configure triggers: on @flamingocode mention in issue/PR comment, or flamingocode label added, pull task into inbox (Batch 5 D10). Trigger only READs GitHub — never comments, closes, or pushes without explicit user action per item. Poll when app open, or via webhook from Automations page.

        Steps Cap
      


      

        Per-task and global setting: maximum agent steps per task (default 50, user-settable 5–500). At the cap the agent stops cleanly, saves a handoff note (what is done, what remains, exact next step), and asks the user to continue (continuing raises the cap for that task). Cap enforced in agent loop; handoff note written to Brain so resumed session starts from exact step.

        Backup & Restore
      

      
      
      

        

          ⚠️
          

            
Sensitive Data Warning

            

              The backup file contains ALL your data including:
              
    
                
  • All sessions (projects, files, chat history)
    • 
                
  • All providers including API keys
    • 
                
  • All agents and team configurations
    • 
                
  • All custom skill packs, plugin packs, and MCP servers
    • 
                
  • All settings (Uncensored Mode, diff review, autonomy, etc.)
    • 
                
  • All checkpoints and brain notes
    •

              Copilot Spaces

              Cross-Session Messaging
            

            

              Send messages to other live sessions via the session API (Batch 6 E15). Messages appear as chat items with Accept/Ignore. Terminated sessions cannot receive. Messages logged on both timelines (G14).
            

            

              
            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Output Style
            

            

              Controls how the agent talks about its work — never changes what it builds. Default: Concise. Per-message override in chat input.
            

            

              
              
              
            

            

              
Per-project default

              
            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Ultrathink Toggle
              
            

            

              Ultrathink gives the agent a bigger thinking budget for hard tasks — more planning passes, deeper verification (extra test round + Adversary). Cost: ≈ 2–3× tokens. OFF by default, never auto-enables. Spend tracked separately in Usage tab.
            

            
Current session Ultrathink spend: 0 tokens

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              SDK / Programmatic API
            

            

              Tiny in-app SDK calling the SAME endpoints as Batch 8a F4 (Serve). No second API, no second auth. Uses per-project key from Serve panel. Copy snippet to use in your scripts.
            

            

// FlamingoCode SDK — copy into your script
const fc = {
  createTask: async (prompt, opts={}) => {
    const res = await fetch('/api/tasks', { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({prompt, ...opts}) });
    return res.json();
  },
  onEvent: (taskId, fn) => {
    const es = new EventSource(`/api/tasks/${taskId}/events`);
    es.onmessage = e => fn(JSON.parse(e.data));
    return () => es.close();
  },
  getResult: async (taskId) => {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${taskId}`);
    return res.json();
  }
};
            

            
          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Model Roles
            

            

              Single roles mechanism (Planner, Coder, Reviewer, Tester). Change a role's model once, updates everywhere. Routes through Batch 5 D3 smart router — respects rate limits.

              AI Checks in CI/CD
              
            

            

              When exporting GitHub Actions YAML, include FlamingoCode checks step (lint, Security Swarm quick profile, review rules). Failures land in autotriage (Batch 6 E12) with fix proposal. Template generated, never auto-committed.
            

            
            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Rules Priority Chain
            

            

              Precedence: .devforge/rules.md > AGENTS.md > steering files > global user rules > built-in defaults. Lower rule NEVER silently overrides higher. Conflicts listed with winner named.
            

            

              
            

            

              
Conflict Resolver

              
              

            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Real-time Multiplayer
              
            

            

              Honest scope: same-project live presence + task status NOW (relay/session sync). True simultaneous editing (OT) NOT built — second editor's save wins with conflict note, never silent overwrite. Full OT is a desktop-stage job.
            

            
Status: Offline

            
No other editors

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Event-Sourced Replay
            

            

              Every agent action is an event in the session store (H1.5). Replay re-runs deterministically from any step — flags divergence (different model output). Never re-applies file write twice without checkpoint.
            

            

              
              
            

            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Process Watcher
            

            

              Long-running processes (dev server, test watch) show live status, stream output, notify on finish/crash. Crashed process files fix task with last output. Survives task end — process keeps running until stopped.
            

            

              
            

            

              
              
              
            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Mid-Task Model Switch
              
            

            

              Switch model mid-task from header picker — keeps plan, completed steps, Brain digest. Logged as session event (G14) with reason: slow / wrong answer / quota / just trying. Never re-runs completed step, never drops checkpoint.
            

            

              
            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Background Agents (Repo Events)
              
            

            

              Triggers on push, PR open, new issue — uses E5 automations engine. Runs job (review PR, triage issue, run tests) without chat window. Result lands in task inbox for review. Never pushes, comments, or merges.
            

            

              
            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Implicit Memories
              
            

            

              Quietly notes what you don't write down: model switches per task type, files opened after build, accepted suggestions. Shown with evidence (\"3 times seen\"). Always visible, deletable. OFF toggle stops collection entirely. Nothing collected silently — panel states what is watched.
            

            

              
            

          

          

            

              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              Ambient Context Tracking
              
            

            

              Tracks what you're looking at (open file, selected symbol, recent searches) — offers quiet suggestion chip (\"No test for this function — write one?\"). Never popup, never interrupts typing. OFF by default. Dismissed kind stops appearing.
            

            
Tracking: Off

            
No dismissed kinds

Never installs without your tap.
